card.name: Benefit outweighs risk wording
card.fires_on: The word benefit(s) or a verb like outweigh, justifies or expected in sentences that say the benefit must outweigh or justify the risk. It marks the benefit-versus-risk comparison in label warnings.

modes.label: Benefit as subject
modes.description: The word benefit or benefits right after 'the' in a benefit-versus-risk condition.
modes.example: Consider if the<< benefit>> of using fibrates concomitantly

modes.label: Outweigh and justify verbs
modes.description: Verbs that complete the comparison of benefit against risk.
modes.example: the expected benefits of using a higher dose opioid clearly<< outweigh>> the substantial risks.
